## Week 1 — Scope, value, and unit economics {#week-01}

Full notes: [Week 1](week-01.qmd) · Readings section: [Week 1 · Readings](week-01.qmd#readings) · 6 listings below (2 main · 4 supplementary).

### Main references {#r01-main}

- [2024 Policy Address, paras. 81–82](https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2024/en/p81.html) — HKSAR. Working definition (generally below 1,000 m) and the Working Group.

- [OHKF, *Taking Flight – Forging a Future for Hong Kong’s Low-Altitude Economy*](https://ourhkfoundation.org.hk/en/events/%E3%80%8A%E6%8C%AF%E7%BF%85%E5%95%9F%E8%88%AA-%E2%80%94-%E9%96%8B%E5%89%B5%E9%A6%99%E6%B8%AF%E4%BD%8E%E7%A9%BA%E7%B6%93%E6%BF%9F%E6%96%B0%E6%9C%AA%E4%BE%86%E3%80%8B%E5%A0%B1%E5%91%8A%E7%99%BC%E5%B8%83%E6%9C%83) — September 2025. ~HK$350 billion industry value-added projection for Hong Kong by 2050.

### Supplementary references {#r01-supp}

**Academic**

- [Straubinger, A., Rothfeld, R., Shamiyeh, M., Büchter, K.-D., Kaiser, J., & Plötner, K. O. (2020). An overview of current research and developments in urban air mobility – Setting the scene for UAM introduction. *Journal of Air Transport Management*, 87, 101852. doi:10.1016/j.jairtraman.2020.101852](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jairtraman.2020.101852) — Widely cited survey of UAM research streams; a good map of the field for week 1.

- [Cohen, A. P., Shaheen, S. A., & Farrar, E. M. (2021). Urban Air Mobility: History, Ecosystem, Market Potential, and Challenges. *IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems*, 22(9), 6074–6087. doi:10.1109/TITS.2021.3082767](https://doi.org/10.1109/TITS.2021.3082767) — Ecosystem and history overview; use for definitions and the stakeholder map. **Caution:** do not reuse its market-forecast figures.

**Official**

- [[宋志勇 (中国民用航空局局长) (2025-01-03). 高质量发展通用航空和低空经济. CAAC website, 民航要闻.]{lang="zh-Hans"}](https://www.caac.gov.cn/XWZX/MHYW/202501/t20250103_226313.html) — CAAC head's own statement of how the Mainland regulator links general aviation and LAE. English gloss: Developing general aviation and the low-altitude economy with high quality.

**Think-tank**

- [[中国信息通信研究院知识产权与创新发展中心 & 中国互联网协会 (2024年12月). 《低空经济政策与产业生态研究报告（2024年）》. CAICT.]{lang="zh-Hans"}](https://www.caict.ac.cn/english/research/whitepapers/202504/P020250401513801693140.pdf) — Mainland definition of LAE (1,000 m, extendable to 3,000 m) and four-part industry ecosystem; contrasts with the HK framing. English gloss: Research Report on Low-Altitude Economy Policy and Industrial Ecosystem (2024).

## Week 2 — Market structure and competition {#week-02}

Full notes: [Week 2](week-02.qmd) · Readings section: [Week 2 · Readings](week-02.qmd#readings) · 5 listings below (1 main · 4 supplementary).

### Main references {#r02-main}

- [2024 Policy Address, paras. 81–82](https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2024/en/p81.html) — HKSAR. Institutional map for Hong Kong LAE.

### Supplementary references {#r02-supp}

**Academic**

- [Pons-Prats, J., Živojinović, T., & Kuljanin, J. (2022). On the understanding of the current status of urban air mobility development and its future prospects: Commuting in a flying vehicle as a new paradigm. *Transportation Research Part E*, 166, 102868. doi:10.1016/j.tre.2022.102868](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.tre.2022.102868) — Reviews players, vehicle types and development status; useful for mapping market structure.

**Official**

- [[深圳市人民代表大会常务委员会 (2023年12月29日通过；2024年2月1日起施行). 《深圳经济特区低空经济产业促进条例》, 公告第一二八号, 深圳市政府公报2024年第4期（总第1319期）.]{lang="zh-Hans"}](https://www.sz.gov.cn/zfgb/2024/gb1319/content/post_11127288.html) — Shenzhen's statute sets who coordinates what (industry vs transport bureaus) and how platforms and associations fit in: the institutional basis of competition in the GBA. English gloss: Shenzhen Special Economic Zone Regulations on Promoting the Low-Altitude Economy Industry.

- [[国家发展和改革委员会 (2023-11). 《关于再次推广借鉴深圳综合改革试点创新举措和典型经验的通知》（发改体改〔2023〕1447号）.]{lang="zh-Hans"}](https://www.ndrc.gov.cn/xxgk/zcfb/tz/202311/t20231116_1361995.html) — NDRC notice spreading Shenzhen reform practices (including LAE) nationwide; evidence on policy diffusion that shapes market entry. English gloss: Notice on again promoting Shenzhen comprehensive-reform pilot innovations and typical experiences.

**Think-tank**

- [World Economic Forum, in collaboration with Kearney (July 2024). *Advanced Air Mobility: Shaping the Future of Aviation* (White Paper).](https://www3.weforum.org/docs/WEF_Advanced_Air_Mobility_2024.pdf) — Systematises AAM use cases and the actor landscape (in collaboration with Kearney).

## Week 3 — Cost structures and revenue management {#week-03}

Full notes: [Week 3](week-03.qmd) · Readings section: [Week 3 · Readings](week-03.qmd#readings) · 5 listings below (1 main · 4 supplementary).

### Main references {#r03-main}

- [NASA, *Urban Air Mobility Market Study*](https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20190001472) — NTRS 20190001472. Official UAM market framing (not an HK government figure).

### Supplementary references {#r03-supp}

**Academic**

- [Rajendran, S., & Srinivas, S. (2020). Air taxi service for urban mobility: A critical review of recent developments, future challenges, and opportunities. *Transportation Research Part E*, 143, 102090. doi:10.1016/j.tre.2020.102090](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.tre.2020.102090) — Covers air-taxi operations, pricing and fleet questions; a good bridge to cost and revenue modelling.

- [Kellermann, R., Biehle, T., & Fischer, L. (2020). Drones for parcel and passenger transportation: A literature review. *Transportation Research Interdisciplinary Perspectives*, 4, 100088. doi:10.1016/j.trip.2019.100088](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.trip.2019.100088) — Parcel and passenger drone literature review; covers cost drivers and operating models.

- [Garrow, L. A., German, B. J., & Leonard, C. E. (2021). Urban air mobility: A comprehensive review and comparative analysis with autonomous and electric ground transportation for informing future research. *Transportation Research Part C*, 132, 103377. doi:10.1016/j.trc.2021.103377](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.trc.2021.103377) — Compares UAM with autonomous and electric ground modes; useful for cost and competition benchmarks.

**Official**

- [[中国民用航空局飞行标准司、航空器适航审定司、空管行业管理办公室 (2022-08-29). 《民用轻小型无人驾驶航空器物流配送试运行审定指南》, 信息通告 IB-TM-2022-05.]{lang="zh-Hans"}](https://www.caac.gov.cn/XXGK/XXGK/GFXWJ/202209/P020220921337984338794.pdf) — CAAC delivery-trial requirements (C2 link, record keeping, insurance, buffers) that turn directly into operating-cost lines. English gloss: Guide to trial-operation certification of light/small civil UAS for logistics delivery.

## Week 4 — Demand modeling in urban air mobility {#week-04}

Full notes: [Week 4](week-04.qmd) · Readings section: [Week 4 · Readings](week-04.qmd#readings) · 5 listings below (1 main · 4 supplementary).

### Main references {#r04-main}

- [NASA, *Urban Air Mobility Market Study*](https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20190001472) — NTRS 20190001472. UAM / AAM market language for cross-checks with lecture models.

### Supplementary references {#r04-supp}

**Academic**

- [Fu, M., Rothfeld, R., & Antoniou, C. (2019). Exploring Preferences for Transportation Modes in an Urban Air Mobility Environment: Munich Case Study. *Transportation Research Record*, 2673(10), 427–442. doi:10.1177/0361198119843858](https://doi.org/10.1177/0361198119843858) — Stated-preference mode-choice model for UAM (Munich); a template for demand estimation.

- [Al Haddad, C., Chaniotakis, E., Straubinger, A., Plötner, K., & Antoniou, C. (2020). Factors affecting the adoption and use of urban air mobility. *Transportation Research Part A*, 132, 696–712. doi:10.1016/j.tra.2019.12.020](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.tra.2019.12.020) — Adoption factors from a survey; inputs for willingness-to-use assumptions.

- [Doole, M., Ellerbroek, J., & Hoekstra, J. (2020). Estimation of traffic density from drone-based delivery in very low level urban airspace. *Journal of Air Transport Management*, 88, 101862. doi:10.1016/j.jairtraman.2020.101862](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jairtraman.2020.101862) — Estimates delivery-drone traffic density from demand scenarios; links demand to airspace load.

**Official**

- [EASA. *Full Report – Study on the societal acceptance of Urban Air Mobility in Europe*. European Union Aviation Safety Agency (publication date not shown on landing page).](https://www.easa.europa.eu/en/full-report-study-societal-acceptance-urban-air-mobility-europe) — n.d. — European regulator's survey of public acceptance; demand-side constraint evidence.

Week 4 readings on the notes page: [Week 4 · Readings](week-04.qmd#readings)

## Week 5 — Infrastructure economics and management {#week-05}

Full notes: [Week 5](week-05.qmd) · Readings section: [Week 5 · Readings](week-05.qmd#readings) · 6 listings below (1 main · 5 supplementary).

### Main references {#r05-main}

- [OHKF, *Taking Flight – Forging a Future for Hong Kong’s Low-Altitude Economy*](https://ourhkfoundation.org.hk/en/events/%E3%80%8A%E6%8C%AF%E7%BF%85%E5%95%9F%E8%88%AA-%E2%80%94-%E9%96%8B%E5%89%B5%E9%A6%99%E6%B8%AF%E4%BD%8E%E7%A9%BA%E7%B6%93%E6%BF%9F%E6%96%B0%E6%9C%AA%E4%BE%86%E3%80%8B%E5%A0%B1%E5%91%8A%E7%99%BC%E5%B8%83%E6%9C%83) — September 2025. Segment structure (infra; education & research; application scenarios; supporting services).

### Supplementary references {#r05-supp}

**Academic**

- [Schweiger, K., & Preis, L. (2022). Urban Air Mobility: Systematic Review of Scientific Publications and Regulations for Vertiport Design and Operations. *Drones*, 6(7), 179. doi:10.3390/drones6070179](https://doi.org/10.3390/drones6070179) — Systematic review of vertiport design and operations research and regulation.

- [Vascik, P. D., & Hansman, R. J. (2018). Scaling Constraints for Urban Air Mobility Operations: Air Traffic Control, Ground Infrastructure, and Noise. *2018 Aviation Technology, Integration, and Operations Conference*, AIAA. doi:10.2514/6.2018-3849](https://doi.org/10.2514/6.2018-3849) — Shows how ATC, ground infrastructure and noise cap UAM scale; a classic infrastructure-bottleneck paper.

**Official**

- [EASA (24 March 2022). *Prototype Technical Design Specifications for Vertiports* (PTS-VPT-DSN).](https://www.easa.europa.eu/en/document-library/general-publications/prototype-technical-design-specifications-vertiports) — Regulator's prototype vertiport design specification; the official design constraint.

- [HKSAR Government (25 June 2025). LCQ3: Developing low-altitude economy. Press release P2025062500305, info.gov.hk.](https://www.info.gov.hk/gia/general/202506/25/P2025062500305.htm) — HK government on 3D spatial data, the CSDI and a unified data-sharing platform as LAE infrastructure.

- [[深圳市人民代表大会常务委员会 (2023年12月29日通过；2024年2月1日起施行). 《深圳经济特区低空经济产业促进条例》, 公告第一二八号, 深圳市政府公报2024年第4期（总第1319期）.]{lang="zh-Hans"}](https://www.sz.gov.cn/zfgb/2024/gb1319/content/post_11127288.html) — Chapter 2 (基础设施) sets out who plans, builds and runs physical and digital low-altitude infrastructure in Shenzhen. English gloss: Shenzhen Special Economic Zone Regulations on Promoting the Low-Altitude Economy Industry. *Also listed in [Week 2](week-02.qmd).*

## Week 10 — Sustainability challenges in urban air operations {#week-10}

Full notes: [Week 10](week-10.qmd) · Readings section: [Week 10 · Readings](week-10.qmd#readings) · 5 listings below (1 main · 4 supplementary).

### Main references {#r10-main}

- [2025 Policy Address, paras. 153–157](https://www.policyaddress.gov.hk/2025/en/p153.html) — HKSAR. Sandbox X and the commitment to formulate an Action Plan.

### Supplementary references {#r10-supp}

**Academic**

- [Stolaroff, J. K., Samaras, C., O'Neill, E. R., Lubers, A., Mitchell, A. S., & Ceperley, D. (2018). Energy use and life cycle greenhouse gas emissions of drones for commercial package delivery. *Nature Communications*, 9, 409. doi:10.1038/s41467-017-02411-5](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-017-02411-5) — Life-cycle energy and GHG of delivery drones compared with ground delivery.

Role of flying cars in sustainable mobility. *Nature Communications*, 10, 1555. doi:10.1038/s41467-019-09426-0](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-019-09426-0) — Life-cycle comparison of VTOL 'flying cars' with cars; the sustainability case and its limits.

- [Vascik, P. D., & Hansman, R. J. (2018). Scaling Constraints for Urban Air Mobility Operations: Air Traffic Control, Ground Infrastructure, and Noise. *2018 Aviation Technology, Integration, and Operations Conference*, AIAA. doi:10.2514/6.2018-3849](https://doi.org/10.2514/6.2018-3849) — Noise as a scaling constraint. *Also listed in [Week 5](week-05.qmd).*

**Official**

- [Rizzi, S. A., Huff, D. L., Boyd, D. D., Bent, P., Henderson, B. S., et al. (October 2020). *Urban Air Mobility Noise: Current Practice, Gaps, and Recommendations*. NASA/TP-20205007433.](https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20205007433) — NASA review of UAM noise practice, gaps and recommendations.
